name: Employee ID
summary: Credential type template for urn:company:id:1, a company employee ID badge in sd_jwt_vc format, without a schema. Subject form groups: Employee (firstName, familyName, email, currentAddress, photo) and Company (companyName, companyRole). Issued and verified by the NOOP custom PKI example wallet template (noop/issuer_verifier_custom_pki), which signs it with an x509 certificate.
